tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

na mo ār+ya lo ke shwa ra ya/ khams gsum gyi sems can kun gyi phyir// dpal rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par bya// don de phyir rang lus spyan ras gzigs// sku mdog dkar zhing mdzes pa can// phyag dang po thugs kar thal mo sbyar// 'og ma gnyis shel 'phreng pad dkar bzung*// drang srong gi cha lugs skyil krung bcas// spyir sems can gyi khar rjer yi dam khyod// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun gyis bskrun// bod 'bangs kyi lha skal nyid du gtad// sgos rgan po nga yi blo ltos ces// tshe 'di phyi bar do'i skyabs gnas zhu// snying thag pa'i 'o dod 'bod lags kyis// mi sdig can bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// snying gar zla dbus hrīḥyig mthar// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ gis bskor// sngags nyung la 'thus pa'i yi ge drug /'di bgrangs pa'i phan yon bsam mi khyab// dus gtan gyi don kun sgrub pa la// yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che// rkyen bar chad bzlog pa'i rgyal po yin// sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub pa la// byin rlabs kyi tshan ka bsam mi khyab// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ sngags 'phreng las thugs ka'i 'od zer 'phros// gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa'i skus// sems can gyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs// mgon sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad mchod// slar byin rlabs bsdus nas rang la thim// yul snang tshad sku la grags tshad gsung*// yid dran tshad thugs kyi rol pa la// blo rtse gcig mos pas gsol ba 'debs// lha khyed dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bya rigs kyi nang so bkras yes kyi/ chos skal du pad+ma dkar pos gtad/// / na mo lo ke shwa ra ya/ srid pa 'di nas ring 'phags nas// sa nas sa la dbang bsgyur ba'i// 'khor lo rin chen spyan ras gzigs// phyogs las rnam rgyal dngos grub stsol// blo mun nag 'joms nyi ma'i 'od// sprin bzhin bsam don char 'bebs pa// nor bu rin chen spyan ras gzigs// phun tshogs kun gyi dngos grub stsol// srid dang zhi ba gnyis 'thung zhing*// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i khur khyer ba// glang po rin chen spyan ras gzigs// bdag cag sgrol ba'i dngos grub stsol// slu 'drid srin po'i do ra nas// dam chos bde ba'i gling skyel ba'i// rta mchog rin chen spyan ras gzigs// bde nas bder bgrod dngos grub stsol// mthong thos dran pa'i dpal gcig pu// zhabs skyes pad+mo mañdzu can// btsun mo rin chen spyan ras gzigs// 'chi med bde reg dngos grub stsol// bzhed pa'i mod la 'gro ba yi// phan pa'i gter rnams kun 'byin pa'i// blon po rin chen spyan ras gzigs// 'phags nor bdun gyi dngos grub stsol// bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams tshar gcod pa'i// byams pa'i snying rje'i ral gri'i gnyen// dmag dpon rin chen spyan ras gzigs// rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/
ma ṇi smon lam bzang po la dgos zer ba ltar pad+ma dkar pos sbyin pa'o// maṅgalaṃ/// /
